argument: two accounting inequalities for refinements and anchor depths; an IID probability bound at termination; exact local volumes with stationary-coupling locality; implied comparisons answered from the global DAG
formalization: Related earlier integer-colour construction; this continuous presentation is not formally verified.
exposition: Sections 1-3 retain the existing exposition, with only the necessary roadmap, global-DAG shortcut, transcript-storage clarification, and cross-reference updates. Section 4 states the supporting guarantees before use, counts refinements and their total anchor depths, and proves the terminal bound by an IID sampling argument. Section 5 proves refinement legality and the anchor guarantees. Section 6 gives exact neighborhood probabilities and a stationary-coupling proof of locality, followed by exact volume enumeration and its bit cost. Section 7 bounds the stored state using incomparable pairs and chooses parameters by a computable cost gate. Appendix A supplies density bounds and cites Prekopa for log-concavity; Appendix B collects the five adversary parameters.
